comparisons.trent: Session VI, Decree on Justification chapter 7 and canon 9 (1547)
comparisons.shared: All address divine grace and Christ's work
comparisons.difference: Trent includes inward renewal in justification; Augsburg presents free justification for Christ's sake through faith; Calvin develops imputation and inseparability of sanctification

comparisons.trent: Session XIII Eucharist decree (1551); Session XXII Mass (1562)
comparisons.augsburg: Article X Real Presence, Article XXII cup for laity, Article XXIV Mass (1530)
comparisons.shared: Eucharist important for all three traditions
comparisons.difference: Real presence formula and mass/sacrifice disputed; Lutheran and Reformed accounts must not be merged

comparisons.trent: Session XXV Saints, Relics, Sacred Images (1563)
comparisons.augsburg: Article XXI Invocation of Saints (1530); not a complete image doctrine
comparisons.calvin: Institutes 1559 I.11 on images, III.20 prayer, IV.9 councils context
comparisons.shared: Debate on legitimate worship and Christian remembrance
comparisons.difference: Trent sanctions veneration under limitations; Augsburg permits remembrance and opposes invocation without scriptural warrant; Calvin has more extensive critique of religious images

edition_policy.calvin: 1559 final Latin version; accessible English translation later
